Portfolio

Mahi Kabra is a model and social media personality who seamlessly straddles mainstream and luxury worlds of beauty and fashion. While she has been featured in beauty campaigns for both Maybelline and Bobbi Brown, she has also represented Alaïa, Dries Van Noten, Isabel Marant, and Louis Vuitton on the runway. With more than 200,000 followers on social media, Kabra captivates followers with glimpses into the life of a model on the rise.
